# Setup

Load libraries:

```{r load-libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
```

Load in plots from example species case studies:

```{r load-results}
grebe_plot <- readRDS("Outputs/Alaotra Grebe/summary_plot.rds")
owlet_plot <- readRDS("Outputs/Forest Owlet/summary_plot.rds")
curlew_plot <- readRDS("Outputs/Slender-billed Curlew/summary_plot.rds")
```

# Plot

Combine plots:

```{r plot}
#| fig-dpi: 600
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 3
ggarrange(grebe_plot, owlet_plot, curlew_plot, ncol = 3)
```
